messages:
incidentbot: PD-9876 fired — HIGH — inference-gateway eu-west1 error-rate spike (5xx > 3% over 2m).
pagerduty: PD-9876 routed to oncall rotation (Marta). Please acknowledge.
Marta: ack — Im taking lead. @Sam @Lina pinged.
Sam: joining now, will check whether this is kv-proxy or model runtime.
Lina: metrics show a jump in kv-proxy socket_close_rate and ephemeral_conn_count on euw-kvpool after the last deploy around 20:29 UTC.
Sam: quick log tail from gateway:
```
2026-03-18T20:52:01Z gateway[euw1] WARN req=xyz upstream=kv-proxy-4 502 "upstream connection reset"
2026-03-18T20:52:04Z gateway[euw1] WARN req=abc upstream=model-srv-2 504 "upstream timeout"
```
Sam: mixed errors — some resets, some timeouts. Could be proxy rollout + drain timing.
Marta: any customer-facing impact? @Jen-CS
Jen-CS: CS: two support tickets from EU customers reporting 5xx. Low count so far, owners notified.
Sam: mitigation plan: reduce concurrency on eu-west1 slice and enable fallback route to stable-model. Applying now.
Sam: ```bash
infractl traffic update --region eu-west1 --max-concurrency 6
infractl set-fallback --region eu-west1 --service stable-model
```
Lina: scaling kv-proxy pool and restarting pods with high close rates.
Lina: ```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=5 -l region=euw1
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy -l region=euw1
```
incidentbot: PD-9876 acknowledged by Marta at 2026-03-18T20:53:10Z
Sam: adjustments applied — observed error_rate_1m drop from ~3.4% to ~1.1%. Health probe returning ~1.0%.
Marta: hold public comms until we sustain <0.5% for 20 minutes.
Lina: restarted 3 problematic pods; socket_closes trending down. Will continue to monitor connections.
Sam: as a precaution initiating rollback of kv-proxy v2.4 -> v2.3 (recent rollout suspect). Link: https://deploys.internal/rollback/kvproxy-v2.4
incidentbot: PD-9876 update: error-rate trending down; check-in in 5m.
Jen-CS: drafting a short customer note in case we need to send it.
Marta: plan: keep fallback + reduced concurrency for 30m, then ramp gradually. Postmortem owner: Sam.
Sam: will collect gateway traces, kv-proxy logs, and host metrics; will post RCA draft to #postmortems within 24h.
Lina: filing infra ticket to add alert on ephemeral_conn_count and to improve graceful-drain behavior during kv-proxy deployments.
incidentbot: PD-9876 resolved by Marta at 2026-03-18T21:18:53Z — final error_rate_1m: 0.15%
Jen-CS: CS: customers informed; awaiting formal RCA for impact statement.
Marta: closing PD after stable window passes. Thanks everyone! :trophy:
